Extraction day: warm the honey room to 28 degrees, uncap frames with the heated knife, spin in the radial extractor, strain through two meshes, and rest in the settling tank overnight. Jar the next morning. Crew: [[neighbor-greenhalgh]] on spinning, one volunteer on cleanup.
